in_marathi.name: Subhadeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, Auspicious, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhadeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subhadeep is a name of Sanskrit and Bengali origin, derived from the Sanskrit words 'subha' (auspicious) and 'deep' (deep, prosperity). It is a name that signifies happiness, success, and prosperity. It is a name for a child who is expected to bring joy and positivity into the family.
